title: Impact of Annealing and Strain on Magnetic and Magnetocaloric Properties of FeNiMnSiGe High-Entropy Alloy Nanoribbons Prepared by Magnetron Co-Sputtering.

recollection.structure: Likely modified nanoribbon structure with potential changes in phase or grain boundaries
recollection.mechanism: Changes in magnetic and magnetocaloric properties due to thermal and mechanical treatments
recollection.results: Possibly improved or altered magnetocaloric effect and magnetic properties, with quantitative data on entropy change or Curie temperature shifts.

score.note: The recollection only repeats the title-level interventions of annealing and strain. Its structural statement is speculative and misses the key finding that the amorphous/short-range-ordered structure persisted while relaxation and short-range reordering occurred. The mechanism is generic, with no mention of pinning-barrier reduction, exchange alignment, magnetoelastic coupling, or spacing-dependent magnetic decoupling. No quantitative results are recalled.
